observed_failure_modes: Delay sensitivity: delayed_I with 2 vs 3 weeks yields materially different behavior across splits, suggesting the effective reporting/realization lag is not stable over the validation window.

Structure ambiguity: SEIR/SEIRS/SEIHR families all appear competitive under rolling-only evaluation, indicating the current search is not discriminating mechanism vs observation mapping; multiple templates can mimic the same short-term dynamics.

Potential overfit to a single validation segment: one configuration shows very strong single validation performance but noticeably worse rolling-average performance and higher rolling variability, consistent with fitting idiosyncratic timing rather than stable dynamics.

Penalty-driven ranking: differences in overall score are strongly influenced by complexity/stability penalties rather than clear separation in rolling-only fit, so small template tweaks may be dominated by penalty effects rather than genuine predictive improvement.
